events.title_en: Ban on Jehovah’s Witnesses in Russia
events.description_en: Russia’s Supreme Court ruled to liquidate the Witnesses’ Administrative Center and local organizations and to criminalize their activity; the ban remained in force nine years later.

sources.title_en: Supreme Court Rules to Criminalize the Activity of Jehovah’s Witnesses in Russia
